title: Repo review plan
description: The review-plan.json document produced by repo_map.py for the repo-review skill: a whole-repo inventory partitioned into risk-ranked, token-budgeted batches for downstream review agents to consume one batch at a time, plus counts of what was excluded and how much of the tree the plan actually covers.

schema_version.description: Document format version. Bump when the shape of review-plan.json changes incompatibly.

commit.description: The full git commit SHA the plan was generated against.

generated_by.description: Producer tag, e.g. "repo_map.py@1" — the tool and its own version that emitted this plan.

tracked.description: Total files tracked by git at `commit`.

reviewable.description: Files remaining after all exclusion categories are removed — the files eligible to appear in `batches`.

est_source_tokens.description: Estimated total token count across all reviewable source files.

excluded.description: Counts of files removed from consideration, by reason. These are disjoint categories that, together with `totals.reviewable`, should account for `totals.tracked`.

vendored.description: Files under a recognized vendored/third-party directory (e.g. node_modules, vendor).

oversize.description: Files that exceeded the per-file size/token ceiling.

non_source.description: Files that are not source code by extension/heuristic (e.g. images, lockfiles, generated data).

explicit.description: Files excluded by an explicit ignore rule (e.g. .repo-review-ignore) rather than a heuristic.

batches.description: The review batches, each independently reviewable, ordered by `risk_rank` (lower = reviewed first).

coverage.description: How much of the reviewable tree the plan actually schedules into batches, and what was left out.

batches_planned.description: Number of batches the planner identified as needed to cover the full reviewable set.

batches_budgeted.description: Number of batches actually included in `batches` under the run's budget (<= batches_planned).

files_covered.description: Count of reviewable files that appear in at least one batch in `batches`.

files_deferred.description: Count of reviewable files not scheduled into any batch this run.

deferred_reason.description: Free-text reason files were deferred (e.g. "batch budget exhausted"), or null when nothing was deferred.

top_deferred_dirs.description: The directories with the most deferred files, most-affected first, for a human to see at a glance what was skipped.

risk_rank.description: 1-based priority order across all batches; lower is reviewed first.

files.description: Repo-relative paths of the files assigned to this batch.

est_tokens.description: Estimated total token count for this batch's files.

modules.description: The top-level module/directory names this batch's files belong to, for human-readable grouping.
